AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_DELIVERY.title: Delivery
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_DELIVERY.description: Temporarily disables a relic. It recovers after [blue]X[/blue] combats. Starter and already disabled relics cannot be selected.\nCards that grant [gold]Delivery[/gold] only perform their subsequent effects after successfully granting [gold]Delivery[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_TRANSIT.title: Transit
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_TRANSIT.description: A relic with Transit [blue]X[/blue] becomes inactive after [blue]X[/blue] combats (including the current combat). Once inactive, it can gain Transit again.
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_ANGEL.title: Angel
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_ANGEL.description: Gain [gold]Retain[/gold]. The first time this card is played after each gain of Angel, it is free. Curse cards are Exhausted immediately when they gain Angel.
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_OVERLOAD.title: Overload
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_OVERLOAD.description: Attack damage is increased by [blue]50%[/blue]. While Overloaded, Ammo is no longer gained or deducted. At the end of your turn, lose all Ammo and exit Overload.
